_doc: Interface and ownership registry for docs/harness/rebuild/. Convention: redesign/INTERFACES.md. harness.design rejects unknown keys, so this metadata cannot live in the .harness files.
_scope: The only center-cluster portion in this repo is the CAN node, plus power and ground to the cluster. Interior cluster wiring lives only in center-cluster-esp32-p4. Do not add interior cluster circuits here. ST185-CAN ends at its CAN-drop terminal t_cluster_can.

A-cabin.physical: ECU connector A to cabin firewall A: ECU-A, cabin half of bulkhead A, the A-pin relay coil (85) wires, broken off to the relays seated in the fuse box (ST185-CabinPower), APS, CSB3 plug, front wheel-speed spur (FL), A/C coolant switch branch, +5V / Gnd Out / +8V / switched-12V splices at ECU A

B-cabin.physical: ECU connector B to cabin firewall B: ECU-B, cabin half of bulkhead B, the B-pin relay coil (85) wires (k_fan2 / k_eps / k_acc in the fuse box, ST185-CabinPower), fuel level branch, rear wheel-speed spur, front wheel-speed FR core, the B legs of +5V / Gnd Out / switched 12V

CabinPower.physical: Cabin power (non-ECU): the glove-box fuse box (LMI + RFRM + 3x MTA, Option B) with the ECU-switched relays seated in it (k_fan2 / k_efi / k_fp / k_str / k_etb / k_fan / k_acc, k_eps HCR150 beside), battery feed ring, fuel pump run to the trunk; ECU coil wires from A-cabin / B-cabin and the A-cabin, B-cabin, A-engine, CSB3 and EngineRoom-C ends arrive broken off

A-engine.physical: Engine harness behind bulkhead A - every engine device whose ECU signal is on connector A

B-engine.physical: Engine harness behind bulkhead B - every engine device whose ECU signal is on connector B, and the ETB motor

HeavyDC.physical: Heavy DC chain (Route 1) - trunk battery, RADLOK firewall pair, starter, 160 A alternator B+, engine-bay jump post, engine block ground. Hands off to EngineRoom-C at the cabin PDB (breaks H1/H2/H3/H6a) - the PDB itself, and everything else it feeds (cabin fuse block, glove-box body block, OEM hot, AM1/AM2), stays on EngineRoom-C.

WheelSpeed-Rear.physical: Rear wheel-speed Y harness - RL/RR ABS drops to the rear VRC endpoints, one screened 4-core output to IX_WS_REAR

WheelSpeed-Front.physical: Front wheel-speed Y harness - FL/FR ABS drops (loom C fender route) to the front VRC endpoints, output pair to IX_WS_FRONT

RearFuel.physical: Rear Fuel - fuel level sender behind IX_FUEL_LVL (the pump run stays on ST185-A-cabin, plan 6.41)

CSB3.physical: ECUMaster CSB3 plug and switch inputs (cruise stalk, clutch, brake, cruise ladder); power, ground, reverse, LED and CAN wires arrive broken off

physicalPartGroups._doc: Different connector ids that are documentation halves of ONE physical part (the DRB102 bulkhead A/B halves). buylist.py counts the housing and its configuration hardware once per group. Lives here because harness.design rejects unknown connector keys.
